content.text:
Found one confirmed correctness bug:

- **P2: Long valid aliases make all refreshes fail.** [Migration line 18](/Users/jamie/development/exposed-transitive-alias-groups-20261012/db/migrations/20261012180317_pipeline_funder_groups.up.sql:18) puts three arbitrary text values in one B-tree primary key. A 1,280-character alias fits the existing `(funder_id, funder_alias)` primary key, but when two funders share it, the new evidence key fails with `index row size 3896 exceeds btree version 4 maximum 2704`. This blocks backfill, declaration loads, and exact retries. Confirmed using transaction-scoped temporary tables in local PostgreSQL; no persistent changes. Reproduction string: `SELECT string_agg(md5(i::text), '') FROM generate_series(1,40) i`. Use a small evidence identity or avoid indexing the full evidence strings; the builder already deduplicates evidence.

Operational gap: [README lines 155–159](/Users/jamie/development/exposed-transitive-alias-groups-20261012/db/README.md:155) should also require refresh after manual changes to funders or aliases. Deleting a bridging alias preserves incorrect merged totals until refresh, while the documented missing-membership check still returns zero. Concurrent manual writers do not obey the loader advisory lock, so they should be paused during backfill.

No further concrete bugs found in policy parsing, connected components, loader refresh placement, exact retries, down migration restoration, CLI wiring, or normal search/detail reads.
